body:
Addressed: The merge conflict in `crates/app/tests/mcp_live/ui_link.rs` now keeps both tests.

Merged main into this branch locally (maintainer edit, approved by the reporter). The resolution keeps the false-server test and the busy-window test. The PR logic is unchanged.

Local merge commit: `15de5b493057915c99adb3719c76c108c5205423`.

Gate: RED. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed 7 of 8 steps. The app prebuild failed with E0433 at `crates/app/src/mcp/link.rs:350-351`. The references to `libc::kill`, `libc::pid_t`, and `libc::EPERM` cannot resolve.

This blocker exists in the original head, `4daf675fd77ae7762b6499b7adbc0b039ddb5620`. That head uses `libc` but declares no direct `libc` dependency in `crates/app/Cargo.toml`.

The pinning tests and clippy could not run because the app does not compile. No push was made. The worktree `.claude/worktrees/fix-3883` remains for the next round.

Please fix the build blocker, then request a new review. This refresh is not ready for review.

Addressed review feedback:
1. Added direct unix dependency on `libc` in `crates/app/Cargo.toml` (`[target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies] libc = "0.2"`). This resolves `libc::kill`, `libc::pid_t`, and `libc::EPERM` for `pid_alive` on unix targets without build errors.
2. Merged `upstream/main` into the branch and resolved the conflict in `crates/app/tests/mcp_live/ui_link.rs`, keeping both the false-server test and the busy-window test.
3. Verification passed:
- `cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-app --test mcp_live ui_link` (7 passed, 0 failed)
- `cargo clippy -j 4 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` (clean)
- Line count: `ui_link.rs` is 271 lines (<= 400 lines)

Ready for a re-check.
